title:
一、英譯中：請將下列英文句子譯成中文。（15 分）
Legal rules can affect our moral beliefs, as well as the operation of the moral sanctions. For instance, a law against discrimination based on race may change beliefs about proper conduct and lead also to a great willingness of individuals to express disapproval when they witness discriminatory behavior.
answer: 法律規範不僅影響道德制裁的運作，也會影響我們的道德信念。例如，禁止種族歧視的法律可能改變人們對合宜行為的看法，也會讓人們在目睹歧視行為時，更願意表達不認同。
hint:
句構拆解
  • Legal rules can affect A, as well as B.：as well as＝以及、不但……也（A 與 B 並列，重點在 A）。
  • the operation of the moral sanctions：道德制裁的「運作」（operation＝運作、實施）。
  • a law against discrimination based on race：against＋名詞（禁止……的法律）；based on race 修飾 discrimination。
  • may change beliefs about proper conduct：change beliefs about＝改變對……的看法。
  • lead also to a great willingness of individuals to express disapproval when they witness discriminatory behavior：lead to＋名詞（導致）；willingness to＋V（願意……）；when 子句表時機。
關鍵詞
  • legal rules 法律規範
  • moral beliefs 道德信念；moral sanctions 道德制裁
  • discrimination based on race 種族歧視
  • proper conduct 合宜行為
  • express disapproval 表達不認同
  • witness 目睹
翻譯技巧
  • as well as 譯「不但……也……」比「以及」更能保留原文的遞進語氣。
  • 「a great willingness of individuals to...」直譯「個人有很大的意願」太生硬，譯「人們更願意……」較順。
  • 英文一句話有兩個動作（change、lead to），中文可拆成兩個短句，用「也會……」連接。
易錯點
  • sanctions 不要譯成「批准」——此處是「制裁」。
  • 「the operation of the moral sanctions」不是「道德制裁的手術」，operation 在此是「運作」。

title:
二、中譯英：請將下列中文句子譯成英文。（15 分）
來自不同文化的人，其價值與規範亦不相同，因此產生文化上的衝突。每個人都習慣根據他自己的文化價值及規範行事，卻未考慮來自不同文化的人，可能用相反的觀點來詮釋他的行為。
answer: People from different cultures hold different values and norms, which gives rise to cultural conflicts. Everyone is used to acting according to his or her own cultural values and norms, without considering that people from other cultures may interpret the same behavior in the opposite way.
hint:
句構策略
  • 原文兩句，英文也建議兩句：①不同文化→不同價值規範→文化衝突；②每個人都依自己的規範行事，卻沒想到別人可能反向解讀。
  • 「來自不同文化的人」→ People from different cultures。
  • 「因此產生文化上的衝突」→ 用關係子句 which gives rise to cultural conflicts（give rise to＝導致）。
  • 「習慣根據……行事」→ is used to acting according to...（be used to + V-ing）。
  • 「卻未考慮……可能用相反的觀點來詮釋」→ without considering that... may interpret the same behavior in the opposite way。
關鍵詞
  • 價值與規範 values and norms
  • 文化衝突 cultural conflicts
  • 習慣於 be used to + V-ing
  • 根據 according to
  • 詮釋 interpret
  • 相反的觀點 the opposite way／a contrary perspective
加分寫法
  • 「因此產生」也可用 and thus create 或 resulting in。
  • 「未考慮」也可用 without realizing that...。
易錯點
  • 「習慣根據……行事」別誤用 used to + 原形（那是「以前常做」）；此處是 be used to + V-ing。
  • 「他自己的」用 his or her own，避免只用 his。

title:
三、英文作文：（20 分）
Write an essay in NO MORE THAN 300 words based on the following descriptions.
“In many educational systems, most provision is made for intellectual education. Moral education is often ignored.” In your essay, you are required to state whether you agree or disagree with this statement with reasons first. Then evaluate the present education system in Taiwan from the two perspectives mentioned above. When you develop your arguments, you are required to provide sufficient supportive illustrations for each of your opinions.
answer:
I largely agree with the statement, though not entirely. Most education systems, including Taiwan's, do devote far more time and money to intellectual education than to moral education, and the imbalance has consequences.

Intellectual education is easier to measure, and what is measured gets funded. Test scores, university admissions, and international rankings all reward knowledge; there is no equivalent index for honesty or empathy. In Taiwan, this is visible everywhere: students spend evenings in cram schools, while classes on ethics are often squeezed into a few hours and treated as a formality. The result is a generation that is well prepared for examinations but rarely asked to reflect on how to treat other people.

That said, I would not say moral education is completely ignored. Taiwan's civic curriculum, service-learning requirements, and school regulations do transmit values, and families and religious groups carry much of the burden. The problem is not absence but imbalance: moral education is treated as an ornament rather than a foundation.

The consequences are practical, not abstract. A society that rewards only test performance produces professionals who may be competent but not trustworthy—an issue that matters greatly in fields such as customs, where integrity is the core qualification. If schools treated honesty, responsibility, and empathy as seriously as mathematics, Taiwan would gain not only better citizens but also a more reliable workforce.

Moral education need not replace intellectual education. It needs equal weight, clear assessment, and teachers who are given time to do it well.
hint:
審題
  • 三個任務：①表態（同意／不同意該說法並給理由）②從兩個角度評估台灣現行教育（智育 vs 德育）③每個論點都要舉例。
  • 字數上限 300 字（不是下限！），建議 260–290 字。
  • 建議立場：大致同意，但不是完全忽略——問題在「失衡」而非「缺席」。
五段架構
  • 第一段（表態）：同意（但保留），點出「失衡」的主張。
  • 第二段（智育為何獨大）：可測量→可獲資源；考試、升學、國際排名都獎勵知識，沒有「誠信指數」。台灣例：補習班、倫理課被擠壓。
  • 第三段（德育並非全無）：公民課、服務學習、校規仍傳遞價值；家庭與宗教團體承擔部分。
  • 第四段（後果＋台灣評估）：只獎勵考試→有能力但不可信；以海關「廉潔是核心資格」為例。
  • 第五段（結論）：德育不需取代智育，需要同等重量、可評量、給教師時間。
關鍵詞彙
  • intellectual education 智育；moral education 德育
  • cram school 補習班；civic curriculum 公民課程
  • service-learning 服務學習
  • integrity 廉潔、誠信；empathy 同理心
  • measurable 可測量的；imbalance 失衡
加分句型
  • What is measured gets funded.（短句有力）
  • The problem is not absence but imbalance.（not A but B 對比）
  • A society that rewards only test performance produces professionals who may be competent but not trustworthy.（雙重關係子句）
  • It needs equal weight, clear assessment, and teachers who are given time to do it well.（三項並列收尾）
評分重點
  • 絕對不可超過 300 字，超過可能扣分。
  • 表態要清楚（agree/disagree），不能含糊。
  • 兩個角度都要談，且各有例子。

title: As Kate gazed at the crystal clear ______, she saw a bird dive into the water to catch a small shrimp.
hint:
1. As Kate gazed at the crystal clear lagoon, she saw a bird dive into the water to catch a small shrimp.
（凱特凝視著清澈見底的潟湖，看見一隻鳥俯衝入水捕捉小蝦。）
  • 考點：lagoon＝潟湖（被沙洲或珊瑚礁圍繞的淺水區）。
  • 線索：crystal clear（清澈）＋a bird dive into the water（鳥俯衝入水）＋shrimp（蝦）→ 水域。
  • 其他選項：landmark 地標；frontier 邊界；limestone 石灰岩。
撇步
  • 清澈、有魚蝦的淺水域 → lagoon。

title: Jolie demonstrated her ______ by showing talents in sports, music, and fine arts.
hint:
2. Jolie demonstrated her versatility by showing talents in sports, music, and fine arts.
（裘莉在運動、音樂與美術上都展現才華，證明了她多才多藝。）
  • 考點：versatility＝多才多藝、多功能（形容詞 versatile）。
  • 線索：talents in sports, music, and fine arts（三個領域都有才華）→ 多才多藝。
  • 其他選項：timidity 膽怯；flexibility 彈性；fidelity 忠誠。
撇步
  • 跨多領域的能力 → versatility。

title: Marathon runners who run for a long period should ______ their diets with sports drinks.
hint:
3. Marathon runners who run for a long period should supplement their diets with sports drinks.
（長時間跑馬拉松的人應該以運動飲料補充飲食。）
  • 考點：supplement A with B＝用 B 補充 A。
  • 線索：marathon runners（跑者）＋sports drinks（運動飲料）→ 補充。
  • 其他選項：constitute 構成；constraint 限制（名詞，詞性不合）；scramble 爭搶、炒蛋。
撇步
  • supplement A with B 是固定搭配。

title: Playing basketball is a popular form of ______ among young people.
hint:
4. Playing basketball is a popular form of recreation among young people.
（打籃球是年輕人之間很受歡迎的一種休閒娛樂。）
  • 考點：recreation＝休閒娛樂（a form of recreation＝一種娛樂方式）。
  • 線索：playing basketball（打籃球）→ 休閒活動。
  • 其他選項：emigration 移居國外；inflection 語調變化；proportion 比例。
撇步
  • 運動、嗜好 → recreation（recreational activities）。

title: The exhibit gives us a ______ of what the young artist might be like in the future.
hint:
5. The exhibit gives us a glimpse of what the young artist might be like in the future.
（這場展覽讓我們得以一窺這位年輕藝術家未來可能的樣貌。）
  • 考點：a glimpse of＝一瞥、一窺（give sb. a glimpse of＝讓某人窺見）。
  • 線索：gives us a ___ of what... might be like（讓我們看見……可能的样子）→ 一窺。
  • 其他選項：groan 呻吟；glamour 魅力；grope 摸索。
撇步
  • give a glimpse of／catch a glimpse of＝一窺、瞥見。

title: The journal paper published a controversial ______ on abortion and stirred a huge debate.
hint:
6. The journal paper published a controversial commentary on abortion and stirred a huge debate.
（該期刊發表了一篇關於墮胎的爭議性評論，引發激烈辯論。）
  • 考點：commentary＝評論、評述（commentary on＝對……的評論）。
  • 線索：journal paper（期刊論文）＋stirred a huge debate（引發辯論）→ 評論文章。
  • 其他選項：acclamation 喝采；accumulation 累積；commitment 承諾。
撇步
  • 期刊上的評論文章 → commentary。

title: The fatal car accident ______ the lives of four young men, all just in their early twenties.
hint:
7. The fatal car accident claimed the lives of four young men, all just in their early twenties.
（那場致命車禍奪走四名二十出頭年輕男子的性命。）
  • 考點：claim lives＝奪走性命（新聞英語固定用法）。
  • 線索：fatal（致命的）＋the lives of four young men → 奪命。
  • 其他選項：bleach 漂白；fatigue 使疲勞；startle 使驚嚇。
撇步
  • 災難「奪走 N 條人命」＝claim N lives。

title: Betty's neat and cozy apartment is like a ______ to her because when she gets home, she feels safe and relaxed.
hint:
8. Betty's neat and cozy apartment is like a sanctuary to her because when she gets home, she feels safe and relaxed.
（貝蒂整潔舒適的公寓對她而言就像避風港，因為一回到家她就感到安全放鬆。）
  • 考點：sanctuary＝避風港、庇護所。
  • 線索：feels safe and relaxed（感到安全放鬆）→ 避風港。
  • 其他選項：district 區域；medium 媒介；propaganda 宣傳。
撇步
  • 安全、放鬆的地方 → sanctuary（近義：haven、refuge）。

title: Parental verbal ______ may leave a permanent scar on children, making them vulnerable to shouting and yelling in their adulthood.
hint:
9. Parental verbal abuse may leave a permanent scar on children, making them vulnerable to shouting and yelling in their adulthood.
（父母的言語虐待可能在孩子身上留下永久的傷痕，使他們成年後容易受到吼叫的傷害。）
  • 考點：verbal abuse＝言語虐待（abuse 虐待、濫用）。
  • 線索：leave a permanent scar（留下永久傷痕）＋shouting and yelling（吼叫）→ 言語虐待。
  • 其他選項：endurance 忍耐；inquiry 詢問；obligation 義務。
撇步
  • verbal abuse、physical abuse、child abuse 都是固定搭配。

title: Many food companies make a ______ of their food products to organizations that feed the hungry free of charge.
hint:
10. Many food companies make a donation of their food products to organizations that feed the hungry free of charge.
（許多食品公司把產品捐贈給免費供養飢民的組織。）
  • 考點：make a donation of＝捐贈（donation 捐贈物）。
  • 線索：organizations that feed the hungry（供養飢民的組織）→ 捐贈。
  • 其他選項：corruption 貪腐；migration 遷徙；sanction 制裁。
撇步
  • make a donation to＝捐贈給……。

title: The process of language extinction is natural. Languages have always    11    into other languages. For example, Latin turned into Italian, and Anglo-Saxon into English. Languages may disappear for many reasons: natural disasters, wars, and diseases. In the 1960s, a group of Western explorers exposed a village in Venezuela to influenza. Having no immunity to the disease, almost the entire village died. That village was the only place where the Trumai language was spoken. In some cases, governments have    12    minority groups to abandon their native languages. In the United States, Canada, and Australia, young speakers of native languages were once forced to attend boarding schools where the use of their mother tongues was    13   . Mass media, such as movies and television, are often    14    for destroying languages, but according to an African language specialist, the biggest threats are actually improved transportation and economic pressure. Young adults move to cities and, to compete for jobs, must learn    15    languages. They then do not teach their children their native tongues.

subItems.hint:
11. Languages have always evolved into other languages.
（語言一直以來都會演化成其他語言。）
  • 考點：evolve into＝演化成（evolve 的過去分詞 evolved）。
  • 線索：Latin turned into Italian, Anglo-Saxon into English（拉丁語變成義大利語……）→ 演化。
  • 其他選項：endanger 危害；engage 參與；exaggerate 誇大。
撇步
  • 語言、物種「演化成」→ evolve into。

12. In some cases, governments have pressured minority groups to abandon their native languages.
（在某些情況下，政府施壓少數族群放棄母語。）
  • 考點：pressure sb. to + V＝施壓某人做某事。
  • 線索：governments（政府）＋abandon their native languages（放棄母語）→ 施壓。
  • 其他選項：sponsor 贊助；ban 禁止；hypothesize 假設。
撇步
  • 政府「迫使」→ pressure / force / compel sb. to V。

13. ...young speakers of native languages were once forced to attend boarding schools where the use of their mother tongues was prohibited.
（……母語使用者曾被強迫進入寄宿學校，在那裡使用母語是被禁止的。）
  • 考點：prohibit＝禁止（be prohibited＝被禁止）。
  • 線索：forced to attend boarding schools（被迫住校）→ 母語被「禁止」。
  • 其他選項：promote 推廣；initiate 發起；inflate 膨脹。
撇步
  • 禁止＝prohibit / ban / forbid。

14. Mass media, such as movies and television, are often blamed for destroying languages...
（電影、電視等大眾媒體常被歸咎為破壞語言的元凶……）
  • 考點：be blamed for＝因……而被責怪。
  • 線索：destroying languages（破壞語言）→ 被「歸咎」。
  • 其他選項：tease 取笑；admire 欽佩；praise 讚揚。
撇步
  • be blamed for 是「被責怪」的固定用法。

15. ...to compete for jobs, must learn majority languages. They then do not teach their children their native tongues.
（……為了競爭工作，必須學習多數人的語言。於是他們不再教孩子母語。）
  • 考點：majority languages＝多數人使用的語言（相對於 native tongues 母語）。
  • 線索：to compete for jobs（為了競爭工作）→ 要學「主流語言」。
  • 其他選項：penalty 罰則；warranty 保證；property 財產。
撇步
  • 對比：majority language（主流語言）vs native tongue（母語）。

title: In Asia, there are a wide variety of cuisines. A typical Chinese meal comprises a carbohydrate, meat or fish and a vegetable. The Chinese cuisine is    16    by its different origin. Often being referred to as the Chinese food by foreigners, Cantonese cuisine from the south of China, for instance, scarcely uses fresh herbs in the cooking. Szechuan and Hunan cuisine from the west of China, however, contains many spicy dishes. Japanese cuisine, on the other hand, values the presentation, spices, and quality of the food. A    17    such as rice or noodles accompanies several side dishes. Some renowned Japanese cuisine includes sushi, sashimi, tempura, and sake. In Korea, spicy food like kimchi is perhaps the most famous one as garlic and chili peppers are widely used in the cooking. They are, namely, the    18    ingredients in most dishes. In Southeast Asia, many dishes and flavors abound. People in Vietnam emphasize the use of herbs, fresh produce, and sauces, but tastes vary in different areas of the country. People in North Vietnam favor spicy food like pho noodles dishes while people in the south prefer sweet tastes and use the herbs    19   . In Thailand likewise, cuisine differs according to geographical differences. In the south, the use of coconut milk in the curries is essential    20    it is the use of lime that is crucial in the northeast. In almost every part of Thailand, both rice and noodles are liked by people. The only difference from other Asian cuisines is that Thai food is usually eaten with a fork and spoon.

subItems.hint:
16. The Chinese cuisine is characterized by its different origin.
（中國菜的特徵在於其源自不同地區。）
  • 考點：be characterized by＝其特徵是……（characterize 以……為特徵）。
  • 線索：後面舉例廣東菜、四川菜、湖南菜 → 說明「特徵」。
  • 其他選項：acknowledge 承認；bombard 轟炸；commemorate 紀念。
撇步
  • be characterized by 是「以……為特色」的固定搭配。

17. A staple such as rice or noodles accompanies several side dishes.
（像米飯或麵條這樣的主食，會搭配幾道配菜。）
  • 考點：staple＝主食（staple food）；此處指「主食」。
  • 線索：rice or noodles（米飯或麵條）→ 主食。
  • 其他選項：notion 概念；query 疑問；utensil 餐具。
撇步
  • 米、麵、麵包 → staple food（主食）。

18. They are, namely, the predominant ingredients in most dishes.
（大蒜與辣椒可說大多數菜餚中最主要的食材。）
  • 考點：predominant＝主要的、占優勢的（predominant ingredients＝主要食材）。
  • 線索：garlic and chili peppers are widely used（大蒜與辣椒被廣泛使用）→ 主要食材。
  • 其他選項：reciprocal 相互的；tentative 暫定的；versatile 多用途的。
撇步
  • 占最大比例、最主要的 → predominant。

19. ...people in the south prefer sweet tastes and use the herbs lavishly.
（……南方人偏好甜味，並大量使用香草。）
  • 考點：lavishly＝大量地、慷慨地（lavish 豐富的）。
  • 線索：prefer sweet tastes（偏好甜味）→ 使用香草「不手軟」。
  • 其他選項：hoarsely 沙啞地；manifestly 明顯地；wearily 疲倦地。
撇步
  • 「大量、慷慨地使用」→ lavishly（近義：generously）。

20. In the south, the use of coconut milk in the curries is essential whereas it is the use of lime that is crucial in the northeast.
（在南部，咖哩使用椰奶是必需的；而在東北部，關鍵則是使用萊姆。）
  • 考點：whereas＝然而、而（對比兩個子句）。
  • 線索：In the south... essential（南部）vs in the northeast... crucial（東北部）→ 對比。
  • 其他選項：otherwise 否則；meanwhile 同時；wherever 無論何處。
撇步
  • 兩個地區、兩種做法的對比 → whereas / while。

title:
“Exercising may be the best antidote to chronic pain,” say doctors at a new clinic for dealing with pain. “People with chronic pain need to stop lying around, go out more and start exercising.” To most people, the intuitive reaction to acute pain is to stop moving and to try to protect the source of pain. But it seems that this is often counterproductive, especially in the case of back pain, which after headaches and tiredness, has become the third most common reason for people to visit their doctors. Painful backs now account for millions of days off work.

Lack of exercise slowly decreases the flexibility and strength of muscles, so it is more difficult to take pressure off the site of pain. Exercise is essential. It releases endorphins, the body's “feel-good” chemicals, which are natural painkillers. In fact, these are so important that researchers are now looking for drugs that can maintain an optimum level of endorphins in the body.

Most patients are prescribed drugs rather than exercise. However, since finding the cause of backache is not so easy, doctors frequently do not know the exact cause of the discomfort, and as the pain continues, patients end up taking stronger doses or a series of different drugs.

A generation of new pain clinics now operates on the basis that drugs are best avoided. Once patients have undergone the initial physical and psychological check up, their medication is cut down as much as possible. Taking patients off drugs also prepares them for physical activity by making them more physically and mentally alert. In some pain-relief clinics, patients begin the day with muscle contraction and relaxation exercises, followed by an hour on exercise bikes. Later in the day, they practice t'ai chi, a Chinese system of calisthenics, self-defense, and meditation. This compares with an average of two-and-a-half hours' physiotherapy a week in a conventional hospital program. “The idea is to strengthen and to increase stamina, flexibility and confidence,” explains Bill Wiles, a consultant pain doctor in Liverpool. “Patients undergoing this therapy get back to work and resume healthy active lifestyles much sooner than those subjected to more conservative treatment”.

subItems.title: 21. What is the best title for the passage?

options.text: A Generation of New Pain Clinics

subItems.hint:
→ The Taming of Pain.
（本文最適合的標題？→ 馴服疼痛。）
  • 主旨：全文談「如何用運動與新療法控制慢性疼痛」，從直覺反應（不動）到新診所的做法（運動、 Cancel 藥物），核心是「控制／馴服疼痛」。
  • 其他選項：(B) 腦內啡只是其中一段；(C) 運動只是手段，且選項有拼字錯誤（Impbrance）；(D) 新診所只是後半段的主題。
撇步
  • 標題要能涵蓋全文的兩個面向（問題：疼痛；解方：運動與療法），「Taming」一詞正好統攝。

subItems.title: 22. According to the passage, which is NOT the instinctive response to severe pain?
subItems.hint:
→ Exercising.
（下列何者不是對劇痛的本能反應？→ 運動。）
  • 定位：第一段「the intuitive reaction to acute pain is to stop moving and to try to protect the source of pain」＋「stop lying around」。
  • 推論：停止移動、保護痛源、躺著都是本能；運動是醫師建議的「反直覺」做法，不是本能。
撇步
  • 否定題：三個是文中明說的本能，剩下那個（運動）就是答案。

subItems.title: 23. Based on the passage, which statement is true?

options.text: T'ai chi prevents people from increasing stamina.
Endorphin is an effective antidote prescribed by doctors.
Physiotherapy has been proven not effective in stopping the pain.
Fatigue is one of the top three reasons why people see a doctor.

subItems.hint:
→ Fatigue is one of the top three reasons why people see a doctor.
（何者為真？→ 疲勞是看醫生的前三大原因之一。）
  • 定位：第一段「back pain, which after headaches and tiredness, has become the third most common reason for people to visit their doctors.」
  • 其他選項：(A) 太極是「增加」耐力（文說 increase stamina）；(B) 腦內啡是人體化學物質，不是醫師開的藥；(C) 文中未說物理治療無效，只說新療法恢復更快。
撇步
  • 細節題回文找「third most common reason」。

subItems.title: 24. When a patient visits a new pain clinic, what is he likely advised to do?

options.text: To reduce the amount of medicine he is taking.
To protect the source of pain.
To lie down to get enough sleep.

subItems.hint:
→ To reduce the amount of medicine he is taking.
（到新疼痛診所，病人最可能被建議什麼？→ 減少用藥量。）
  • 定位：第四段「their medication is cut down as much as possible」——新診所的原則是「盡量避免藥物」。
  • 其他選項：(A) 減少腦內啡（相反，運動會釋放）；(C) 保護痛源（是本能反應，不是新建議）；(D) 躺著（文中說要 stop lying around）。
撇步
  • 問「新建議」→ 找 cut down medication / avoid drugs。

subItems.title: 25. According to the passage, why does new therapy help patients resume healthy active lifestyles sooner than conservative treatment?

options.text: Because it directly treats the source of pain.
Because it prescribes stronger doses and a series of different drugs.
Because it enhances patients' physical and psychological conditions.
Because it gives patients the drugs that act locally on the inflammation, such as aspirin.

subItems.hint:
→ Because it enhances patients' physical and psychological conditions.
（為什麼新療法能讓病人更快恢復健康積極的生活？→ 因為它改善病人的身心狀況。）
  • 定位：第四段「Taking patients off drugs also prepares them for physical activity by making them more physically and mentally alert」＋「The idea is to strengthen and to increase stamina, flexibility and confidence」。
  • 其他選項：(A) 直接治療痛源（文中說痛源難找）；(B) 開更強劑量的藥（相反）；(D) 開局部消炎藥（未提）。
撇步
  • 因果題抓 physically and mentally alert、stamina / flexibility / confidence。
